lital01.title: Define the research stream
lital01.caption: Real topic entries for experimental high-energy physics and phenomenology. Each query is paired with a named webhook environment variable.
lital01.code:
topics:
  - id: hep-ex
    title: "High Energy Physics - Experiment"
    webhook_env: "DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL_HEP_EX"
    arxiv_url: "https://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query=cat:hep-ex&sortBy=submittedDate&sortOrder=descending&max_results=100"

  - id: hep-ph
    title: "High Energy Physics - Phenomenology"
    webhook_env: "DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL_HEP_PH"
    arxiv_url: "https://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query=cat:hep-ph&sortBy=submittedDate&sortOrder=descending&max_results=100"

lital02.title: Bind the delivery destination
lital02.caption: The actual HEP workflow step exposes repository secrets as environment variables and passes topics/hep.yml to the runner. These are secret references, not webhook values.

lital03.title: Set the automation clock
lital03.caption: The project runs daily at 08:00 UTC, or 05:00 São Paulo time, and exposes topic and time-window inputs for manual runs.
lital03.code:
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 8 * * *"   # daily at 08:00 UTC = 05:00 BRT (UTC-3)
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      only_topic:
        description: "Run only this topic id (default: all)"
        required: false
        default: "all"
        type: string
      time_frame:
        description: "Days back (default: 1) or 'all'"
        required: false
        default: "1"
        type: string

lital04.title: Read the runner defaults
lital04.caption: These defaults are read from environment variables at startup. Set an override in the workflow step’s env block to change a value.
lital04.code:
TIME_FRAME_RAW = os.getenv("TIME_FRAME", "1").strip().lower()   # "1", "7", "30", "360", "all"
ONLY_TOPIC = os.getenv("ONLY_TOPIC", "all").strip()             # "all" or a topic id  # >>> CHANGED
MODE = os.getenv("MODE", "auto").strip().lower()               # "auto" | "per_paper" | "summary"
REQUEST_TIMEOUT = int(os.getenv("REQUEST_TIMEOUT", "20"))

POST_DELAY_SECONDS = float(os.getenv("POST_DELAY_SECONDS", "0.4"))
MAX_RETRIES_429 = int(os.getenv("MAX_RETRIES_429", "8"))
DISCORD_CHUNK_LIMIT = int(os.getenv("DISCORD_CHUNK_LIMIT", "1800"))

MAX_POSTS_PER_TOPIC = int(os.getenv("MAX_POSTS_PER_TOPIC", "0"))  # 0 = no cap after time filter

# Safety: if too many papers, force summary (prevents floods / 429)  # >>> CHANGED
SUMMARY_THRESHOLD = int(os.getenv("SUMMARY_THRESHOLD", "50"))

lital05.title: Understand the execution summary
lital05.caption: The actual summary code prints fetched articles, papers that pass the date filter, successful posts and failures. In summary mode, posted counts refer to message chunks, not individual papers.
lital05.code:
# --- SUMMARY ---
    print("---")
    print(f"Total results on arXiv   : {total_available}")
    print(f"Total fetched from arXiv : {total_fetched}")
    print(f"Passed time filter       : {len(papers)}")
    print(f"Successfully posted      : {posted_ok}")
    print(f"Failed to post           : {posted_fail}")
